thread:
riley-marketing: Quick ask for tomorrow's rehearsal: tiny 'needlepoint' probe to validate coldstart + cached behavior across three payload sizes. Need deliverables by 08:30 PT.

Specs: 24 requests (8 short/8 med/8 long), models: redwood-7b fp16 and opt-7b-q4 fallback. Baseline without KV cache and one cached comparison. Deliverables: latencies.csv (include seq_len), p50/p90/p99, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces for p95+, and one logits snapshot for any long-case p99. Keep total wall time <20m.

noah-runtime: We can run it. Two quick Qs: (1) include node tag in CSV? (2) traces: sample p95+ and first cold request per node?

riley-marketing: Yes to node tag. Yes to the sampling policy.

lee-platform: Heads up: shared pool maintenance 03:00-04:00 PT. Recommend slot at 06:30 PT to avoid noisy windows.

noah-runtime: Scheduling baseline 06:30 PT (run_id=nb-2769999950) and cached run 07:05 PT. Concurrency capped at 3. Outputs: latencies.csv, percentiles.png, heatmap.png, traces.tgz, logits_snapshots.tar.gz.

bench-bot: Job queued nb-2769999950 (est 12m).

ops-bot: nb-2769999950 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/nb-2769999950/needlepoint_probe.tar.gz

riley-marketing: Downloaded. One long-case p99 spike at req-012. Can you attach trace and logits and a short note?

noah-runtime: Included traces/req-012.json and snapshots/logits-req-012.npy.gz in the tarball. Quick note: p99 aligns with a transient allocator GC on host gpu-dedicated-11 during first-token decode; infra-related rather than model runtime. Re-ran the single long request on gpu-dedicated-12, no spike.

lee-platform: We'll flag gpu-dedicated-11 for follow-up and prefer gpu-dedicated-12 for the rehearsal slot.

riley-marketing: Can you paste a 3-bullet summary marketing can copy into the rehearsal doc?

noah-runtime: Summary: "Needlepoint probe (n=24 across short/med/long) on redwood-7b (fp16) with opt-7b-q4 fallback. Artifacts: per-request latencies (with seq_len & node), percentile plots, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces (p95+), and logits snapshot for long-case p99. Observed isolated p99 tied to allocator GC on gpu-dedicated-11; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-12. Recommendation: reserve gpu-dedicated-12 for rehearsal and monitor overnight."

riley-marketing: Perfect 600 Thanks all :rocket: Closing thread.
